newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Index shows Austrian consumers still pessimistic.
newsitem.headline: Index shows Austrian consumers still pessimistic.

text.p: Consumer confidence in Austria was up in October from July, but Austrians still were strongly pessimistic about their economic prospects, a new index published by research institute IMAS showed on Monday.
The index, compiled since the beginning of 1996, showed confidence among consumers had grown to 74.1 in October after hitting a low of 63.0 in July, the Linz-based institute told a news briefing.
Any reading around 100 points indicated a neutral evaluation, it said. A high figure pointed to optimism among the population, while a low result meant a gloomy view of the economic climate.
The findings were based on some 1,000 interviews with Austrians, the Linz-based institute said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
